_: Shipyard's keyboard shortcuts, read by the webview (lib/shortcuts.ts: the handlers, the Keyboard shortcuts sheet, Settings → Shortcuts) and by the Mac app's menu bar (src-tauri/src/lib.rs). group is the menu an item is in; accel, when set, puts it there with that accelerator, so macOS cannot take the key first. count makes items 1..count, with {n} in label and accel. Never give ⌘C, ⌘V, ⌘A or ⌘F an accelerator: focused terminals and text need them.

shortcuts.label: Compare with…
shortcuts.what: Compare the worktree you're in with another, side by side

shortcuts.label: Close group
shortcuts.what: Close the tab group (its worktree and agents carry on); with one group, the window

shortcuts.label: Rename worktree…
shortcuts.what: On a worktree in the sidebar or the rail: give it a display name. ↵ keeps it, esc leaves it

shortcuts.label: Compare lanes
shortcuts.what: In a Compare tab: its Chat, Diff, Preview, Terminal or Artifacts lane

shortcuts.label: Swap compared sides
shortcuts.what: In a Compare tab: swap its two sides

shortcuts.label: Files panel
shortcuts.what: Show or hide the worktree's files beside its tabs: everything, or what the agent changed this turn

shortcuts.label: Console and network
shortcuts.what: In a Browser tab: show or hide the page's Console and Network drawer

shortcuts.label: Go to file…
shortcuts.what: Find a file in the worktree in front: what the agent changed this turn first. ↵ opens it in a File tab, ⌥↵ beside the pane, ⌘↵ in your editor

shortcuts.label: Save file
shortcuts.what: In a File tab: save it. If the agent wrote the file since, you choose what to keep instead

shortcuts.label: Tab {n}
shortcuts.what: Go to tab 1–9

shortcuts.label: Move between panes
shortcuts.what: Move between panes, out of a terminal too (a terminal keeps ⇥ for itself)

shortcuts.label: Find in the chat
shortcuts.what: In a chat: find words in it; ↵ or ⌘G for the next, esc to close

shortcuts.label: Send the reply
shortcuts.what: In a reply box: send it; ⇧↵ for a new line

shortcuts.label: Stop the agent
shortcuts.what: In a chat's reply box while its agent works: stop it, as esc does at its terminal

shortcuts.label: Fold a project
shortcuts.what: On a project in the sidebar: hide or show its worktrees

shortcuts.label: Open a row's menu
shortcuts.what: On a sidebar row or a tab: its menu, as a right-click opens it

shortcuts.label: Add a worktree's tabs as a group
Back
shortcuts.what: The place you were before: a worktree, Home or a view (command layout)

shortcuts.label: Forward
shortcuts.what: Forward again after going back (command layout)

shortcuts.label: Next agent that needs you
shortcuts.what: Go to the agent waiting longest for you; again for the next one (command layout)

shortcuts.label: Pinned worktree
shortcuts.what: A pinned worktree by its number; ⌘↵ in the switcher pins one, and ⌃1–9 picks a tab (command layout)

shortcuts.label: Settings
shortcuts.what: Open Settings (command layout)
